visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a simple 2D animated character featuring a yellow hood and brown pants, set against a plain light blue background. The character has a rounded body and a minimalist face with two black dots for eyes. Text in English and Traditional Chinese appears above the character. (2) The scene transitions to a sunset landscape over a body of water with birds flying in the distance. The animated character's face becomes significantly more detailed and stylized with thick eyebrows and a defined jawline, and their hands are held together in a prayer-like gesture. (3) A graphic of a plastic cup containing brown bubble tea with black pearls and a white straw appears to the right of the praying character against the same sunset background. (4) The bubble tea graphic is replaced by a physical product image of the 'Dynasty Warriors: Origins' video game box for the PlayStation 5. (5) The game box disappears, focusing again on the detailed character who remains in the prayer position. (6) The background switches to solid black, and the camera zooms in closely on the character's face, showing a very intense, serious, and slightly aggressive expression with furrowed brows.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful male voice speaks clearly in English over a bouncy, light-hearted electronic pop music bed with a steady beat. (2) The music undergoes a hard cut to a dramatic orchestral string section featuring deep cellos and swelling violins. The male voice shifts into a deep, overly-dramatic, soap-opera-esque serious tone. (3) As the speaker lists activities, the cinematic music continues with high intensity, mirroring the character's mock-serious pleading. (4) The music cuts out almost entirely, leaving a low ambient hum as the voice delivers a final, serious ultimatum in a hushed, breathy tone with high articulation.
